_note: hand-authored 1940s port-clutter sites (no third-party licence); generated by tools/make_port_clutter_1940.py. Positions are the real WGS84 port coordinates already recorded in the v4.0 WorldPopulator.PORTS table (and documented dock/route references), cited per record. The scenery is procedural low-poly toon from GroundKit primitives plus GroundShip hulls; no third-party geometry, imagery or data file was copied.
